871.speaker: Lucita Azaro
871.text: "But I understand that the King's decision was necessary in light of our depleting energy stores."
871.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_EnergyCrisis"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_LopsidedAgreement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_SmallerShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_NoShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_SmallerShare"]) == false)

872.speaker: Lucita Azaro
872.text: "We're not even desperate for energy. How much will our enemies be able to squeeze out of us when we actually need something?"
872.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Economy_EnergyCrisis"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Wehlen_LopsidedAgreement"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_SmallerShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Nationalization_NoShare"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.MITZ_Renegotiation_SmallerShare"]) == false)

873.speaker: Player_Romus
873.text: "Rizia is a generous neighbor that negotiates peaceful compromises. That's the image I want to project to the world."

874.speaker: Player_Romus
874.text: "You make a valid point, but I can't do anything about it now."

877.speaker: Elena Werner
877.text: "And you're both overlooking the fact that a large store of energy will give Rizia an edge in any future negotiations."

878.speaker: Player_Romus
878.text: "It was absolutely necessary. I'm glad you recognize that."
